===Levels 6–99: Other combination runes===
{{#vardefine:rote|{{#expr:({{GEP|Law rune}}+{{GEP|Air rune}}+{{GEP|Fire rune}}+{{GEP|Water rune}}+{{GEP|Earth rune}})}}}}
{{#vardefine:bind|{{#expr:({{GEP|Binding necklace}}/16)}}}}
{{#vardefine:astral2|{{GEP|Astral rune|2}}}}
{{#vardefine:ess|{{GEP|Pure essence}}}}
{{#vardefine:estamhr|{{#expr:{{GEP|Extended stamina potion(4)}}*1.75}}}}
{{#vardefine:waterTalisman|{{GEP|Water talisman}}}}
{{#vardefine:earthTalisman|{{GEP|Earth talisman}}}}
{{#vardefine:fireTalisman|{{GEP|Fire talisman}}}}
{{#vardefine:airTalisman|{{GEP|Air talisman}}}}
{{#vardefine:mudWaterProfit|{{#expr:{{GEP|Mud rune}}-{{GEP|Earth rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:mudWaterProfitRaiments|{{#expr:{{GEP|Mud rune}}*1.6-{{GEP|Earth rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:mudEarthProfit|{{#expr:{{GEP|Mud rune}}-{{GEP|Water rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:mudEarthProfitRaiments|{{#expr:{{GEP|Mud rune}}*1.6-{{GEP|Water rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:steamWaterProfit|{{#expr:{{GEP|Steam rune}}-{{GEP|Fire rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:steamWaterProfitRaiments|{{#expr:{{GEP|Steam rune}}*1.6-{{GEP|Fire rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:steamFireProfit|{{#expr:{{GEP|Steam rune}}-{{GEP|Water rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:steamFireProfitRaiments|{{#expr:{{GEP|Steam rune}}*1.6-{{GEP|Water rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:smokeProfit|{{#expr:{{GEP|Smoke rune}}-{{GEP|Air rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:smokeProfitRaiments|{{#expr:{{GEP|Smoke rune}}*1.6-{{GEP|Air rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:mistProfit|{{#expr:{{GEP|Mist rune}}-{{GEP|Air rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}
{{#vardefine:mistProfitRaiments|{{#expr:{{GEP|Mist rune}}*1.6-{{GEP|Air rune}}-{{#var:ess}}}}}}

Crafting other [[combination rune]]s is a profitable alternative to [[lava rune]]s. The methods are almost identical, only bringing different runes and talismans and/or teleporting to a different elemental altar. The [[Water Altar]] has higher experience rates because [[ring of the elements]] teleports closer to it and the inside of the altar itself is smaller. This decrease in lap time outweighs the slight XP loss per essence compared to other altars. Also, because these laps are faster, more runes are crafted, so with [[Magic Imbue]] the best XP rate altar is also the most profitable.
